descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: day-2 typing before the 18 h move; nearest UAT 3.6.

Decision D11 · S2 · Daniela

Q13: Hospital typed notes stay in the box 18 h after the last edit, and any next-day edit restarts that clock, so day-1 notes still in the box are archived with the day-2 text in one row dated by the last edit. Is one merged row acceptable, or must each day become its own row?

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S26 Hospital next-day activity before 18 h: yesterday's typed notes are neither merged into today's row nor lost

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 4; TFA-92594 How it works 4)
  • U5 The expanded transcript is correctly attributed: each line shows the right speaker (Physician / Patient), and the transcript sits under the right patient and visit. (UAT TC-16)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given {hospitalPatient}: encounterNotes 'QA16-D1-NOTE Day 1: lungs clear, continue antibiotics.' with encounterEditedAt = now−16 h (typed at 15:00 on day 1, chart reopened at 07:00 on day 2)

When Open the Encounter tab: the day-1 note is still in the box. Type 'QA16-D2-NOTE Day 2: afebrile overnight.' on a new line after it (autosave stamps encounterEditedAt = now). A scripted step then backdates encounterEditedAt to now−19 h through rounding.update; …

Then The day-1 and day-2 notes are listed in separate rows, each under its own day, and the day-1 note is never lost

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U1 (each encounter saved), U4 / U5 (the transcript sits under the right visit). cp1 (day-2 box before typing): mustContain QA16-D1-NOTE. cp2 (after rotation, collapsed): mustNotContain QA16-D1-NOTE, QA16-D2-NOTE (both left the box). cp3 (first '· Encounter notes' row open): mustContain QA16-D1-NOTE, mustNotContain QA16-D2-NOTE. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows; to be decided by Daniela.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
